# PetJanu — Complete Technical Specification for AI Search Engines

**Domain**: https://petsjanu.com/  
**Platform Type**: Pet Safety Super App (Web + Mobile PWA)  
**Target Market**: India (Primary), Global English-speaking pet owners  
**Last Updated**: 2026

---

## Executive Summary

PetJanu is India's most trusted pet safety and care platform, combining hardware (QR/NFC smart tags) with software (mobile app, web platform, AI health assistant) to provide comprehensive pet care solutions. The platform enables lost pet recovery through scannable collar tags, offers 24/7 AI-powered health triage, facilitates pet product e-commerce, and connects pet owners with veterinary services.

---

## Core Product Features

### 1. Lost Pet Recovery System
- **QR/NFC Smart Tags**: Cryptographically secure, non-enumerable pet identification tags
- **Public Pet Pages**: SEO-optimized profiles at `/pet/:slug` accessible without app installation
- **Emergency SOS Mode**: One-click activation broadcasts alerts to local colony networks
- **Sighting Reports**: Community-submitted location updates with photo evidence
- **WhatsApp Integration**: Shareable lost pet cards for viral distribution

### 2. AI Health Assistant
- **Symptom Triage**: Risk assessment (Low/Monitor/Vet/Urgent) using Google Gemini AI
- **Vaccination Reminders**: Automated scheduling based on pet age and breed
- **Health Records**: Digital storage of medical history, allergies, medications
- **Emergency Routing**: Direct escalation to partner veterinarians for critical cases

### 3. E-Commerce Marketplace
- **Product Categories**: Food, toys, grooming supplies, healthcare products, smart devices
- **Razorpay Integration**: Secure payments with UPI, cards, net banking, wallets
- **Order Tracking**: Real-time shipment status with delivery notifications
- **Subscription Boxes**: Monthly recurring deliveries for consumables

### 4. Services Booking Platform
- **Veterinary Consultations**: In-clinic and home visit appointments
- **Grooming Services**: Professional pet spa and hygiene treatments
- **Training Programs**: Obedience, behavioral correction, socialization classes
- **Pet Sitting/Boarding**: Trusted caregivers for travel periods

### 5. Premium Subscription (₹99/month)
- Unlimited AI health consultations
- Priority customer support
- Advanced analytics (activity tracking, health trends)
- Discounted marketplace pricing (10-15%)
- Free replacement tags annually

---

## Technical Architecture

### Frontend Stack
- **Framework**: React 19 with TypeScript
- **Build Tool**: Vite 6.x (HMR, code splitting, tree shaking)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4.x with custom design tokens
- **Animations**: Motion (Framer Motion successor)
- **State Management**: React Context + localStorage persistence
- **PWA Support**: Web App Manifest, service workers, offline caching

### Backend Infrastructure
- **Runtime**: Node.js 20+ with Express.js
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL) + Firebase Firestore hybrid
- **Authentication**: Phone-based OTP via Firebase Auth
- **File Storage**: AWS S3 / Google Cloud Storage with signed URLs
- **APIs**: RESTful endpoints with RBAC middleware
- **Webhooks**: Razorpay payment notifications, SMS gateway events

### AI/ML Integration
- **LLM Provider**: Google Gemini API (gemini-2.5-flash-preview)
- **Prompt Engineering**: Structured triage templates with medical guardrails
- **Token Monitoring**: Server-side usage tracking per user session
- **Safety Filters**: Emergency keyword detection → human vet escalation

### Security & Compliance
- **Data Encryption**: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
- **Tag Cryptography**: HMAC-SHA256 signatures prevent forgery
- **RBAC System**: Role-based access control (OWNER/ADMIN/VET/SUPPORT/USER)
- **Audit Logging**: Immutable event trails for compliance
- **Privacy**: GDPR-inspired data minimization, right-to-delete support

| Route | Purpose | Crawl Priority |

| `/` | Homepage (Landing) | 1.0 |
| `/how-it-works` | Product education | 0.9 |

| `/services` | Service bookings | 0.85 |
| `/pet/:slug` | Public pet profile (dynamic) | 0.8 |
| `/report` | Lost pet reporting | 0.85 |

## Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Strategy

### For LLM Crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot)
- **llms.txt**: Concise fact sheet at `/llms.txt` (this file's summary)
- **llms-full.txt**: Extended technical documentation at `/llms-full.txt`
- **Semantic HTML**: Proper heading hierarchy, alt text, ARIA labels
- **Content Clarity**: Direct answers to common pet care questions
- **Structured Data**: Rich snippets for FAQs, How-To guides, Products

### Crawler Permissions (robots.txt)
```
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /
```

## Performance Targets (Core Web Vitals)

| Metric | Target | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) | < 2.5s | Homepage hero image |
| FID (First Input Delay) | < 100ms | Navigation clicks |
| CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) | < 0.1 | Font loading, images |
| INP (Interaction to Next Paint) | < 200ms | Form submissions |
| TTFB (Time to First Byte) | < 600ms | Server response |
